About us 
 Salience Labs is building the optical infrastructure that will power the next generation of AI. Our photonic switching technology delivers the high-speed, ultra-low latency networking fabrics AI datacenters need and can’t get anywhere else. We’re a multi-disciplinary team of physicists, engineers, and machine learning specialists on a mission to remove the bottlenecks holding AI infrastructure back.
 The Role 
 You’ll write the software that puts our OCS technology to work for AI. You’ll develop and benchmark custom kernel code on modern AI accelerator hardware, and help define how AI workloads are deployed across training, inference, and agentic use cases. You’ll follow the latest techniques in distributed AI systems and help shape the networks and network devices that come next.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop, test, and document custom kernel code for contemporary AI accelerator hardware
 Develop and run benchmark tests for kernel code, document the results, and derive optimization strategies
 Contribute to the definition and implementation of our AI workload deployment ecosystem
 Track the latest techniques for writing and deploying communication kernels in distributed AI accelerator systems
 Contribute to designing deployment strategies for our OCS technology, tailored to each AI/ML workload type (training, inference, agentic)
 Play a vital role in the definition and design space exploration of novel networks and network devices
 What We’re Looking For 
 Very good programming skills in one or more higher-level languages, with strong experience in C++ and Python
 A deep understanding of AI accelerator hardware programming models
 Good knowledge of distributed shared memory architecture concepts
 You like being part of a team and being helpful to others
 Curiosity, innovative thinking, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of technology
 Good written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to broad audiences
 Desirable 
 Knowledge of AI/ML and/or HPC workloads and the communication patterns they create
 Knowledge of CUDA and/or NCCL kernels and how they operate on hardware
 Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and their internal architecture
 Familiarity with deploying multi-node compute tasks on compute clusters
 Detailed knowledge of hardware and/or software systems for high performance networking, with GPU architecture and programming models a particular advantage

items.jobTitle: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
items.jobDescription:
Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable
Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.
About the Team
The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.
You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.
The Challenge
Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:
 Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.
 Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.
 Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.
 Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.
 Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.
 Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.
 Your Role
As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.
Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.
What You’ll Do
 Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.
 Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.
 Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.
 Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.
 Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.
 Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.
 Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.
 Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.
 Who Are You?
 First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.
 You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.
 You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.
 You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.
 You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.
 You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
 You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).
 Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.
 More information?
Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.
 Only application submitted through the website will be considered.  
 Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics.  
 It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

items.jobDescription:
Zukunft. Gemeinsam. Entwickeln. 
Im Mittelpunkt der Forschungsarbeit des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Nachrichtentechnik – HHI stehen exzellente Forschung und Innovationen. Dabei sind wir weltweit führend in der Erforschung von mobilen und optischen Kommunikationsnetzen und -systemen sowie der Kodierung von Videosignalen und Datenverarbeitung. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gehen Sie mit uns auf Forschungs- und Innovationsreise!
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Verantwortung für den technischen Betrieb, die Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Systeme zur präzisen Chipmontage und Mikrointegration von Halbleiterbauelementen
 Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Montage- und Justageprozessen zur hochpräzisen optischen Kopplung photonischer und optoelektronischer Baugruppen
 Entwicklung, Auslegung und Umsetzung optoelektronischer Module sowie zugehöriger Schaltungsträger vom Prototypen bis zur Kleinserie
 Planung, Qualifizierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Fertigungs- und Montageprozessen im Bereich der optoelektronischen Aufbau- und Verbindungstechnik
 Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer sowie elektronischer Baugruppen mittels 3D-CAD und PCB-Design unter Berücksichtigung technologischer und fertigungstechnischer Anforderungen
 Eigenständige Entwicklung innovativer Konzepte zur Steigerung von Prozessstabilität, Fertigungsqualität und technologischer Leistungsfähigkeit
 Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Spezifikationen und qualitätsrelevanter Dokumente gemäß geltenden Normen und Qualitätsstandards
 Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Wissenschaftlerinnen bei der Konzeption und Realisierung innovativer photonischer Technologien und Systeme
 Sicherstellung einer hohen technischen Verfügbarkeit komplexer Forschungs- und Fertigungsanlagen durch systematische Zustandsbewertung,
 Wartungsplanung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Anlagenperformance
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor) der Aufbau- und Verbindungstechnik, Mikrosystemtechnik oder Elektrotechnik
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Montage, Integration und Charakterisierung elektronischer oder optoelektronischer Baugruppen sowie Interesse an Fertigungs- und Verbindungstechnologien im Bereich der Mikrosystemtechnik
 Erfahrung im Bereich der photonischen Aufbautechnik, sowohl praktisch als auch in der Konzepterstellung und Realisierung
 Kenntnisse im 3D-Design, Leiterplattendesign, in der optischen Simulation
 Sicheres manuelles Hantieren von Mikrobauelementen und Baugruppen
 Freude am Betrieb von komplexen Fertigungsanlagen
 Feinmotorische manuelle Begabung
 Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
 Ausgeprägtes Fehlerbewusstsein
 Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit
 Sehr gute deutsche (Mindestvoraussetzung C1 Niveau) und englische Sprachkenntnisse
 Kommunikationsgeschick und Teamgeist, eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine zielorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Motivation, sich in neue Themengebiete hineinzudenken
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Extrem interessante Herausforderungen in einem wissenschaftlich und zugleich unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld
 Attraktives Gehaltspaket nach TVöD mit 30 Tagen Urlaub, Altersvorsorge (VBL), vermögenswirksame Leistungen (VWL)
 Moderner, exzellent ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlins
 Offene und sehr kooperative Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem internationalen Team
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten
 Umfangreiche Fortbildungs-, Gesundheits- und Sportangebote
 Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte und vergünstigtes BVG-Ticket
 Angebote für Familien (Eltern-Kind-Büro, Notfallbetreuung, Freizeitangebote)
 Die Stelle ist zunächst 2 Jahre befristet. Eine Verlängerung ist explizit erwünscht.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden.  
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.   
 Fraunhofer-Institut für Nachrichtentechnik, Heinrich-Hertz-Institut HHI  
 www.hhi.fraunhofer.de

 Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ( www.fraunhofer.de ) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
 Zukunft. Gemeinsam. Entwickeln. 
Im Mittelpunkt der Forschungsarbeit des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Nachrichtentechnik – HHI stehen exzellente Forschung und Innovationen. Dabei sind wir weltweit führend in der Erforschung von mobilen und optischen Kommunikationsnetzen und -systemen sowie der Kodierung von Videosignalen und Datenverarbeitung. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gehen Sie mit uns auf Forschungs- und Innovationsreise!
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Verantwortung für den technischen Betrieb, die Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Systeme zur präzisen Chipmontage und Mikrointegration von Halbleiterbauelementen
 Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Montage- und Justageprozessen zur hochpräzisen optischen Kopplung photonischer und optoelektronischer Baugruppen
 Entwicklung, Auslegung und Umsetzung optoelektronischer Module sowie zugehöriger Schaltungsträger vom Prototypen bis zur Kleinserie
 Planung, Qualifizierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Fertigungs- und Montageprozessen im Bereich der optoelektronischen Aufbau- und Verbindungstechnik
 Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer sowie elektronischer Baugruppen mittels 3D-CAD und PCB-Design unter Berücksichtigung technologischer und fertigungstechnischer Anforderungen
 Eigenständige Entwicklung innovativer Konzepte zur Steigerung von Prozessstabilität, Fertigungsqualität und technologischer Leistungsfähigkeit
 Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Spezifikationen und qualitätsrelevanter Dokumente gemäß geltenden Normen und Qualitätsstandards
 Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Wissenschaftlerinnen bei der Konzeption und Realisierung innovativer photonischer Technologien und Systeme
 Sicherstellung einer hohen technischen Verfügbarkeit komplexer Forschungs- und Fertigungsanlagen durch systematische Zustandsbewertung,
 Wartungsplanung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Anlagenperformance
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor) der Aufbau- und Verbindungstechnik, Mikrosystemtechnik oder Elektrotechnik
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Montage, Integration und Charakterisierung elektronischer oder optoelektronischer Baugruppen sowie Interesse an Fertigungs- und Verbindungstechnologien im Bereich der Mikrosystemtechnik
 Erfahrung im Bereich der photonischen Aufbautechnik, sowohl praktisch als auch in der Konzepterstellung und Realisierung
 Kenntnisse im 3D-Design, Leiterplattendesign, in der optischen Simulation
 Sicheres manuelles Hantieren von Mikrobauelementen und Baugruppen
 Freude am Betrieb von komplexen Fertigungsanlagen
 Feinmotorische manuelle Begabung
 Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
 Ausgeprägtes Fehlerbewusstsein
 Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit
 Sehr gute deutsche (Mindestvoraussetzung C1 Niveau) und englische Sprachkenntnisse
 Kommunikationsgeschick und Teamgeist, eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine zielorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Motivation, sich in neue Themengebiete hineinzudenken
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Extrem interessante Herausforderungen in einem wissenschaftlich und zugleich unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld
 Attraktives Gehaltspaket nach TVöD mit 30 Tagen Urlaub, Altersvorsorge (VBL), vermögenswirksame Leistungen (VWL)
 Moderner, exzellent ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlins
 Offene und sehr kooperative Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem internationalen Team
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten
 Umfangreiche Fortbildungs-, Gesundheits- und Sportangebote
 Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte und vergünstigtes BVG-Ticket
 Angebote für Familien (Eltern-Kind-Büro, Notfallbetreuung, Freizeitangebote)
 Die Stelle ist zunächst 2 Jahre befristet. Eine Verlängerung ist explizit erwünscht.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden.  
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.

At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.
 Robotics Application Engineer – Rhoda AI GmbH (Germany) 
 About Rhoda AI GmbH 
Rhoda AI GmbH is Rhoda AI's first international entity, established to own strategic partner relationships across Europe and drive deployment of Robotics as a Service (RaaS). It's a small, high-ownership team: you'll work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one, with a direct line to our engineering organization in Silicon Valley.
 About the Application Engineering Team 
Application Engineering is where Rhoda's AI meets the real world. We work directly with customers and strategic partners to understand their operational problems, determine where our platform can deliver value, and lead the application of Rhoda's AI model end to end — from model post-training and data collection, to robot tooling and work-cell design, to production deployments on the customer's floor. The team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, deployment operations, and business, with members in the US and Germany. Application Engineering is organized into three complementary roles — Application Engineers, Solution Engineers, and Technical Program Managers.
 The Role 
As a Robotics Application Engineer, you are a core member of Rhoda AI's European team and the hands-on technical lead in the early stages of a partner engagement — Scoping, Proof of Principle (POP), and Proof of Concept (POC) — through to RaaS deployment. You'll determine whether a use case is feasible, design and prototype the end effectors and task tooling a robot needs to do the job, write the data collection procedures that feed our models, and post-train Rhoda's AI model to perform the task. You'll spend real time on partner sites across Europe standing up POCs and showing what our platform can do.
 You'll also serve as a key technical bridge between our European partners and Rhoda HQ Engineering, owning the feedback loop that turns field findings into product improvements.
 What You'll Do 
 Scope new partner use cases alongside the commercial team: ask the right questions, assess technical feasibility, and make go/no-go recommendations.
 Design, prototype, and iterate on end effectors and task-specific tooling for real-world manipulation tasks.
 Author and refine data collection SOPs, and work with teleoperation and ML ops teams to gather high-quality training data.
 Post-train and evaluate Rhoda's AI model on partner tasks, driving performance toward POC success criteria.
 Lead on-site POP/POC setup and execution, including model training, daily reporting, validation, and direct partner interaction, and author the final technical report.
 Partner with Solution Engineers on task engineering and solution design input as engagements move toward production.
 Review proposals and provide technical feedback ahead of purchase orders.
 Support model training through Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), deployment, and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
 Lead root cause analysis for issues surfaced during deployments, troubleshooting across hardware, firmware, and software until the real cause is found.
 Share field learnings with product and engineering in Silicon Valley, translating partner-reported issues into prioritized, actionable input for the roadmap.
 Present clear, non-technical summaries of technical outcomes to partner leadership, and work with the commercial team to tie them to commercial milestones.
 What You'll Bring 
 BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 3–8 years of hands-on experience in robotics, automation, systems integration, or applied engineering in an industrial setting, including real-world deployments or field installations.
 Strong mechanical design skills, including CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion) and rapid prototyping (3D printing, machining, off-the-shelf components).
 Working knowledge of machine learning workflows — data collection, training, and evaluation — and comfort working in Python.
 Experience with robot arms, grippers, and sensors (cameras, depth sensors, LiDAR, IMUs) in real environments, including integration and calibration.
 Proven track record conducting root cause analysis on complex systems spanning hardware, firmware, and software.
 Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity in high-stakes environments.
 Clear communicator who can explain technical tradeoffs to partners, executives, and internal teams. Fluent English required; German at working level minimum.
 Willingness to travel approximately 40% across Europe, including extended on-site POC periods, with occasional travel to the US.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with imitation learning, VLA models, world models, or robot foundation models.
 Background in factory automation, material handling, or logistics.
 Experience in a customer-facing technical role (application, field, FDE, or sales engineering) at a robotics OEM, system integrator, or corporate automation department.
 Familiarity with teleoperation systems or remote robot management workflows.
 Experience with ROS/ROS2, embedded Linux, or C/Rust for onboard software.
 Why Rhoda AI GmbH 
 Work on real customer problems, not lab demos: our robots are ready for field deployment directly after a successful POC.
 Direct line to HQ Engineering — your field intelligence shapes the product roadmap.
 Small, high-ownership team where you work with the Managing Director and Commercial Lead as peers from day one.

items.jobDescription:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!
   Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.
   What you'll do 
   We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.
   Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.
   In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.
   In this role, you will:
 Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib
 Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality
 Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review
 Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation
 Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle
 Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage
 Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems
   Who you are 
   Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:
 Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer
 Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation
 Understand and promote software development best practices
 Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions
 Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted
 Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team
   Now, it would be fantastic if you: 
 Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring
 Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role
 Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment
   What we offer 
 Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
 Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care 
 Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
 Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
 A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
 Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
 ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
 For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
   The interview process 
 A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team
 A coding interview
 An agentics system design
 A behavioural interview
 Reference check
   Job details 
 Permanent position
 Full Time
 Workplace: Levallois
 Start date : As soon as possible

   At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it! 
   The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. 🪐 Discover our galaxy 
 Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: 
 - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries 
 - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth 
 - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI 
 - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently 
 Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 
 Explore your future career  🔭 
 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML).
 Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion.
 Some of the questions you might explore :
 - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ?  What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions?
 - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? 
 - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior?
 Key responsibilities ✨ 
 Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency.
 Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions.
 External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media.
 Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms. 
 Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity.
 About you 🧑‍🚀 
 Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background
 Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models).
 Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand.
 Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake).
 Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions.
 Full professional proficiency in English. 
 If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you!
 How to join the mission? 🚀 
 First call with Luke our Tech Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and explore a few technical topics (45 mins)
 Interview with Marc (Director of ML), your future manager, to discuss your experience, the role in more detail and ask you a few technical questions (60 mins).
 Research discussion with your future colleagues to walk through two pieces of work: a research project of your choice, and one proposed by us. (90 mins)
 Take-home coding test (2 hours or optional if you have enough open source projects online)
 Final interview (45mins) with Claire (CTO)
 Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫 
 - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris 
 - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options  
 - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave 
 - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow 
 - Team building events organized every year 
 Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐  
 At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.

Meet Arago and the Aragonians 
 Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.
 The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.
 Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.
 Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.
   What you’ll do 
 As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production.
 Required Skills and Experience 
 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort.
 Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus.
 Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type).
 MBIST and memory repair integration.
 JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers.
 ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement.
 DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks.
 Test-mode SDC / STA understanding.
 Scripting: Tcl, Python.
 Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug.
 Language: English at a proficient level.
 Responsibilities 
 Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team.
 Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off.
 Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks.
 Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure.
 Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up.
 Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house.
 Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow.
 Preferred Qualification 
 Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below).
 Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs.
 Hierarchical DFT on large designs.
 Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch.
 Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure.
 Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight).
 Pay and benefits 
 Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.
 Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).
 Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.
 Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

items.jobTitle: Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Thermische Beschichtungssysteme  (IGP-2026-19)
items.jobDescription:
class="jobdescription"> BEI UNS GEHT ES UM GROSSE KONSTRUKTIONEN – UND GROSSEN SCHAFFENSDRANG.  VERÄNDERUNG STARTET MIT UNS.  
 Sie wollen in spannenden Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten Großes bewegen? Dann kommen Sie ins Fraunhofer-Institut für Großstrukturen in der Produktionstechnik IGP. Hier entwickeln wir innovative Produkte und Prozesse für den Bau und Betrieb großer komplexer Konstruktionen wie Windräder, Flugzeuge und Frachtschiffe – und bringen sie mit Industriepartnern wichtiger Zukunftsbranchen in die Umsetzung. Unsere Themen: Fertigungsverfahren, Automatisierungs- und Qualitätstechnik, Unternehmensorganisation und Produktentwicklung. Welches ist Ihres?  
 Neben klassischen Anwendungen für Luftfahrt oder Verschleißschutz rückt das thermische Spritzen als Verfahrensgruppe zunehmend auch in den o.g. Bereichen der Industrie in den Fokus. Das Team Thermische Beschichtungssysteme des Fraunhofer IGP verfügt hierfür neben hochwertiger Laborausstattung über ein vollständig SPS-integriertes Beschichtungszentrum sowie diverse mobile Beschichtungsprozesse zur Herstellung thermisch gespritzter Schichten nach modernsten Qualitätsstandards sowie dazugehöriges integriertes Prozessmonitoring. Wir verbinden Oberflächentechnik, praxisnahe Prüfverfahren und den Transfer in anwendungsrelevante Umgebungen. 
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Eigenständige Bearbeitung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsaufgaben im Bereich thermischer Beschichtungssysteme (z. B. Entwicklung, Bewertung und Optimierung von Funktionsschichten und Oberflächenkonzepten). 
 Entwicklung und Optimierung von Beschichtungs- und Oberflächenkonzepten sowie zugehörigen Fertigungs- und Prüfverfahren (z. B. Ausführung thermischer Spritzverfahren, Werkstoffauswahl, Prozessparameter, Qualitätssicherung und Oberflächenvorbehandlung). 
 Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation wissenschaftlicher Untersuchungen und Versuchsreihen (z. B. Beschichtungsversuche, Probenherstellung und Demonstratorenaufbau). 
 Wissenschaftliche Auswertung und Bewertung von Forschungsdaten (z. B. Charakterisierung von Beschichtungen hinsichtlich Schichtdicke, Rauheit, Mikrostruktur, Porosität, Haftfestigkeit und Beständigkeit). 
 Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus Wissenschaft und Industrie (z. B. Abstimmung fachlicher Anforderungen, Versuchsprogramme und Forschungsergebnisse in Forschungs- und Verbundprojekten). 
 Dokumentation, Veröffentlichung und Präsentation von Forschungsergebnissen sowie Unterstützung des Technologietransfers (z. B. Berichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzbeiträge, Vorträge und industrielle Anwendung der Forschungsergebnisse). 
 Sie betreuen wissenschaftliche Nachwuchskräfte und wirken bei der fachlichen Anleitung von Studierenden, Praktikantinnen und Praktikanten sowie wissenschaftlichen Hilfskräften mit. 
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Für die erfolgreiche Ausübung der Tätigkeit bringen Sie Folgendes mit:
 Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master oder Universitätsdiplom) der Werkstoffwissenschaften, Oberflächentechnik, des Maschinenbaus, der Physik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. 
 Die Möglichkeit zur Promotion ist gegeben - eine Promotionsabsicht wird vorausgesetzt.
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von Forschungs- und Entwicklungsaufgaben im Bereich der Oberflächen- und Beschichtungstechnik. 
 Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung, Herstellung, Charakterisierung und Bewertung von Werkstoffen, Beschichtungen und Oberflächen, insbesondere in der Analytik von Beschichtungen. 
 Erfahrung in der Planung, Durchführung, Auswertung und Dokumentation wissenschaftlicher Untersuchungen und Versuchsreihen, insbesondere in der Oberflächentechnik. 
 Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen wissenschaftlichen Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise. 
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus Wissenschaft und Industrie. 
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens Niveau C1 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER), die eine sichere Erstellung wissenschaftlicher und technischer Dokumentationen sowie die Zusammenarbeit im Forschungsumfeld ermöglichen
 Wünschenswert sind: 
 Kenntnisse im Bereich funktionaler, hygienischer, antiadhäsiver oder keimreduzierender Oberflächen sowie Erfahrungen mit entsprechenden Prüf- und Bewertungsverfahren. 
 Kenntnisse im Versuchsdesign, in der statistischen Auswertung von Messdaten sowie in der digitalen Erfassung und Auswertung von Prozessdaten. 
 Anwendungskenntnisse in den Bereichen Landtechnik, Tierhaltungstechnik, Hygienetechnik, Lebensmitteltechnik, Medizintechnik oder verwandten Branchen. 
 Erfahrungen in öffentlich geförderten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten sowie im wissenschaftlichen Schreiben, Publizieren und Präsentieren von Forschungsergebnissen. 
 Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Auf Sie wartet ein offenes & motiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien und ein moderner Arbeitsplatz in einem renommierten Forschungsinstitut. 
 Work-Life-Balance ist Ihnen wichtig? Mit unserem Gleitzeitkonto und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten können Sie Karriere, Familie und Freizeit bestmöglich vereinbaren. Außerdem können Sie sich auf Homeofficemöglichkeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub + arbeitsfrei an Heiligabend und Silvester freuen. 
 Heute schon an morgen denken – wir versichern Sie über die VBL, unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und bieten Ihnen zudem vermögenswirksame Leistungen. 
 Mit dem Novembergehalt erhalten Sie eine Jahressonderzahlung. 
 Wir begleiten Sie auf Ihrem Karriereweg und bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Angebot zur beruflichen Weiterbildung und Qualifizierung. 
 Ob mit einem Zuschuss zum Jobticket oder die kostenlosen Auto- und Fahrradstellplätze – mit uns kommen Sie auf Ihre Art und stressfrei zur Arbeit. 
 Sie können täglich aus dem vielfältigen Mensaangebot wählen, welches Ihnen durch unsere Kooperation mit der Universität Rostock zu reduzierten Preisen zur Verfügung steht.

Who We Are 
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
 The Role 
 The Workflow Platform team builds Addepar's orchestration layer: a platform, on top of Temporal, that lets other Addepar teams turn long-running, multi-step business processes (approvals, data operations, reporting, client notifications) into reliable, observable, human-in-the-loop workflows. As part of the platform offering we own: Task Centre, where users act on the work workflows assign to them; the Executions view, where teams monitor and manage running workflows; and Client Notifications.
 We're adding a senior full-stack engineer in Edinburgh. To begin with you'll mostly work on the user-facing side of the platform, and you'll also work on the services behind it. Our engineers work across the stack and in more than one language. Whichever side is newer to you, we'll give you real work there and the support to grow into it. You'll be given high-impact projects to lead end to end, such as a new Task Centre surface, the Executions view, or the components product teams use to build their own task types. You'll work closely with Product and Design to shape what we build, and with our Staff-level tech lead on how we build it, alongside colleagues in Pune and the US and the product teams building on the platform.
 Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Own the design and delivery of a defined area of the platform end to end, from interface to API: write the design, break it into deliverable slices, ship it and support it in production.
 Build user-facing features in React and TypeScript that make complex, long-running workflows clear and actionable for the people working in them.
 Work on the services behind those experiences (Python and Java APIs and workflow workers), and shape API contracts so the front end and back end evolve together.
 Make the platform easier for other teams to build on: reusable UI components and patterns, clear contracts, and documentation that lets them self-serve.
 Spot gaps and opportunities in your area and act on them without waiting for direction.
 Write RFCs for your area, present them at our weekly Architecture Working Group, and contribute to design reviews of others' work.
 Share in running what we build: observability, debugging live issues, incident response and our on-call rotation.
 Share what you know with less-experienced engineers through code review, pairing and design discussion.
 Help the team use AI-assisted development effectively and responsibly.
 Who You Are 
 Extensive software engineering experience, much of it building web front ends, with a track record of taking features from design to production.
 Strong in TypeScript and a modern component framework (we use React), including state management, data fetching and testing UI code.
 Has worked on the backend of products they've built (APIs, data models, services) in any language, and wants to do more of it.
 Cares about usability and accessibility. Can turn a rough requirement into an interface people can use without a manual, with or without a finished design.
 Designs UIs for systems that are slow, asynchronous or failing: loading, partial and error states, retries and stale data.
 Makes and owns decisions in their area, including when established processes don't fully fit.
 Finds and closes gaps in their area without waiting to be told.
 Collaborates across teams without a manager driving alignment, and uses clear reasoning and evidence to influence decisions in their area.
 Our Values  
 Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.  
 Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.  
 Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.

Change the way the world travels

 Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust.  Incident management & reliability

 Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done
 Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster
 Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement
 Observability & production confidence 
 Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting
 Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue
 Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist
 Change confidence & release quality 
 Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing
 Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them
 Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation
 Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices
 Platform enablement 
 Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default
 Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene
 Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices
 Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities
 Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices
 Your toolkit 
 8+ years of relevant industry experience
 Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective
 Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale
 Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams
 Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)
 Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology
 Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems
 Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work
 You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to:
 You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises
 You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams

TL;DR: 
We're looking for a full-stack engineer who wants to sit at the heart of Lovable's marketing engine - making every pound of spend measurable, and every manual workflow a tool. One sprint you're tracing spend from first click to revenue across Meta, Google and newer channels; the next you're shipping landing pages, experiments or an agent that saves the team hours a week. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: can we measure it, and does it help us grow faster?
 Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + marketing obsession = you. 
 Why Lovable? 
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
 What we’re looking for 
 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.
 Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.
 Knowledge of Meta Pixel and Google Ad Network APIs, and experience working with data from ad networks. Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit and Beehiiv, plus CTV/podcast tracking, is a plus.
 Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.
 Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems "right" from the start.
 Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.
 Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.
 Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.
 What you’ll do 
 In one sentence: You'll sit between marketing and engineering and build whatever we need to grow faster, from the site and tracking to the tools the team uses every day - expect to be driving the thinking here alongside our team leads.
 Build the tools marketing runs on: Find the manual work slowing the team down and replace it with tools, automations or agents, ideally built on Lovable.
 Shape what gets built: Work with design, marketing, data and partnerships to decide what's worth doing, then own it end to end.
 Own how we measure marketing: Make sure every pound of spend can be traced from first click to revenue, across Meta and Google and newer channels like CTV and podcast. This is what lets us scale spend with confidence.
 Make experimentation cheap & fast: Build the events, funnels and A/B testing setup that let the team test an idea in days and double down on what works.
 Turn the website into a growth surface: Ship landing pages, signup flows and first-run moments that get new users to value fast, without waiting in a product queue.
 Keep it Lovable: Growth should feel like part of the product, never bolted on.
 Our tech stack 
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
 Frontend: React
 Backend: Golang and Rust
 Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
 DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)
 About your application 
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

 Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.

 How We Work

 Where You'll Be

Über CUREosity
 CUREosity ist ein innovatives Med-Tech-Startup aus Düsseldorf, das die Gesundheitsbranche mit Virtual-Reality-Therapien revolutioniert. Unsere mehrfach ausgezeichneten Lösungen verbessern die Rehabilitation für Patient*innen weltweit.
Zur Verstärkung unserer internen IT suchen wir eine*n IT-Systemadministrator*in. Die Stelle ist bewusst als Teilzeitstelle mit 20 Stunden pro Woche angelegt – ideal, wenn du Job und Familie vereinbaren möchtest, nebenher selbstständig bist, dich berufsbegleitend weiterbildest oder einfach nicht mehr 40 Stunden arbeiten willst. Gemeinsam mit unserem Head of IT verantwortest du einen sicheren und stabilen IT-Betrieb in einem Aufgabenumfang, der auf 20 Stunden zugeschnitten ist.
 Was uns ausmacht
 Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Wir entwickeln innovative Therapien, die Menschen wirklich helfen
 Innovative Technologie: Wir setzen auf VR für bessere Therapieergebnisse
 Teamgeist und Vielfalt: Ein diverses, internationales Team mit unterschiedlichen Perspektiven und Hintergründen
 Start-Up Atmosphäre: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Kommunikationswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft der Rehabilitation zu gestalten?
 Deine Mission
 Du administrierst und betreust unsere IT-Infrastruktur mit Schwerpunkt auf Netzwerken, Servern und IT-Sicherheit.
 Firewalls, VPN-Verbindungen und Netzwerkkomponenten konfigurierst, wartest und überwachst du zuverlässig.
 Beim Patch-, Update- und Schwachstellenmanagement setzt du technische Sicherheitsmaßnahmen um und härtest unsere Systeme.
 Du betreust unsere Microsoft-365-Umgebung inklusive Benutzerkonten sowie Zugriffs- und Berechtigungsstrukturen.
 Treten Störungen auf, findest du die Ursache und sorgst mit Monitoring und funktionierenden Backups für einen stabilen Betrieb.
 Gemeinsam mit unserem Head of IT dokumentierst du Änderungen und entwickelst Ideen, um Abläufe durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung oder besseres Monitoring zu verbessern.
 Du analysierst bestehende IT-Prozesse und Workflows, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Konzepte zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Infrastruktur, z. B. durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung oder besseres Monitoring.
 Dein Profil
 Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker*in für Systemintegration, ein IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung
 Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Systemadministration, in der du Netzwerke und Server eigenständig betreut hast
 Sicherer Umgang mit Netzwerken (TCP/IP, VLANs, Routing), Firewalls und VPN-Technologien
 Solide Grundlagen in IT-Sicherheit, Systemhärtung und der Absicherung von Netzwerken

Über Buena 
 Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs - vom Suchen über das Kaufen bis zum Finanzieren. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und verwandeln sie in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. 
 Über die Rolle
 Wir suchen einen hands-on, datengetriebenen Growth Engineer, der als erste Person die technische Basis für unser Brokerage-Geschäft baut. Du verbindest unsere Verwaltungsdaten aus über 70.000 Einheiten mit CRM, Outreach-Tools und KI und baust daraus ein System, das automatisch erkennt, welche Eigentümer verkaufen wollen. Dadurch kommen wir gezielt mit verkaufswilligen Eigentümern ins Gespräch und können qualifizierte Leads an unsere Makler übermitteln.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Inside-Sales-Team sowie dem Leadership-Team zusammen und baust Brokerage zu einem eigenen, profitablen Geschäftsfeld aus. Brokerage ist bei Buena noch ein kleines Geschäftsfeld, mit dir soll daraus ein Multi-Millionen-Geschäft werden.
 Deine Verantwortlichkeiten
 Signal-Engine bauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.
 Outreach automatisieren: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.
 Funnel messbar machen: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat und trackst Kosten pro Lead sowie Conversion.
 Experimente fahren: Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst und misst es sauber.
 Du passt, wenn du
 Hands-on Erfahrung als GTM Engineer, in Growth oder RevOps mitbringst und Systeme selbst gebaut hast.
 Schon einmal etwas von null aufgebaut hast, etwa als Gründer, Geschäftsführer oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase.
 Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise hast, also Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.
 Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) beherrschst. Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.
 Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.
 Deine Benefits 
 Top-Vergütung inklusive VSOPs. 
 Bis zu 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros im Prenzlauer Berg.
 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat.
 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.
 Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.
 Warum jetzt einsteigen 
 Du baust unsere Akquise-Engine von null auf. Was du in den ersten Monaten aufsetzt, wird zur Grundlage des ganzen Geschäftsfelds. Wenn es funktioniert, skalierst du es selbst weiter und deine Rolle wächst mit.
 Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt aufs Geschäft. Du hast Zugriff auf Daten aus unserem Verwaltungsbestand, die sonst niemand hat und arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen: Jedes Signal, das funktioniert, wird zu messbarem Umsatz im Brokerage.
 Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitenden im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

 Deine Aufgaben

 abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur/zum staatlich geprüften Techniker/in, Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbare für die Tätigkeit relevante Fachrichtung
 langjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb von komplexen elektrischen Versorgungsnetzen im Bereich Schwachstrom

 gute EDV-Kenntnisse in MS-Office sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und nachweisbare deutsche Sprachkenntnisse nach Niveau C1
 Kenntnisse in MS-Office sowie in der Anwendung und Auslegung von anzuwendenden Normen und Verordnungen im Aufgabengebiet (BGV A3, DIN-VDE, UVV, z.B. DIN VDE 0800, DIN EN 50173 etc.)
 Bereitschaft zur Durchführung von Rufbereitschaft zur Sicherstellung der Funktionalität der Anlagen

Meet Arago and the Aragonians 
 Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.
 The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.
 Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.
 Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.
   What you’ll do
 At Argo, we're building across the entire computing stack, bringing together multiple fields of engineering and cutting-edge technologies. Operating at the intersection of some of the fastest-growing and most exciting industries, we offer a unique opportunity to work on breakthrough innovations across a wide range of technical domains. This is an ideal environment for an ambitious patent engineer eager to broaden their expertise, tackle complex challenges, and grow in a fast-paced, innovation-driven company.
 Responsibilities
 Patent Drafting: Translate early-stage technical ideas into compelling, well-structured patent applications.
 IP Strategy: Identify and prioritize high-value patent opportunities aligned with our technological ambitions.
 Patent Landscaping: Explore existing patents, alternative technologies, and untapped IP opportunities.
 Portfolio Management: Coordinate patent filings, external counsel, and long-term IP development.
 Required Skills and Experience
 Background in patent engineering, intellectual property law, or a related technical field.
 Strong understanding of photonics, semiconductors, electronics, deep learning, computing architectures, or related technologies.
 Excellent technical writing and patent drafting skills.
 Ability to turn limited technical input into structured, defensible IP assets.
 Strategic, independent, creative, and results-driven mindset.
 Professional proficiency in English.
 Pay and benefits 
 Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.
 Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).
 Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.
 Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

 About Tailscale  
 Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.
 About the Role 
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tailscale, you’ll be the bridge between our technical capabilities and the needs of our most strategic customers. You will work directly with customers to ensure their success with Tailscale’s products, helping them get onboarded, driving their long-term adoption, and providing expert technical guidance throughout their journey. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and an empathetic customer-centric approach to ensure customers are fully empowered to leverage the power of Tailscale. The role will report directly to the Team Lead, Customer Success Engineers.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead and manage the onboarding process for new strategic customers, ensuring they quickly understand and adopt Tailscale. Provide training and resources that set customers up for long-term success.
 Offer technical support for customers, diagnosing and resolving issues across Tailscale's platform. Assist with configuration, integration, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth implementation.
 Conduct QBRs with customers to review usage, success metrics, and future goals. Use these touchpoints to identify opportunities for deeper engagement and horizontal expansion.
 Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor. Help customers optimize their use of Tailscale by identifying best practices, and by providing recommendations based on their specific use cases and desired business outcomes.
 Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback and insights to the product and engineering teams to help improve the product and the customer experience.
 Work closely with sales, product, engineering, and support teams to ensure smooth handoffs, escalate critical issues, and drive customer success across the organization.
 Develop and maintain a repository of technical documentation, FAQs, and guides to help customers self-serve. Share insights and best practices with both the customer and internal teams.
 What We Are Looking For 
 6+ Years in a technical role with minimum 2 years of customer-facing experience (Solutions engineer/architect, Sr. Support Engineer, etc.)
 Experience working with enterprise customers in a consultative capacity
 Strong understanding of networking, VPNs, and security principles. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and other DevOps technologies
 Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer/architect, or Customer Success Engineer at a SaaS company
 Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to a diverse audience, from non-technical stakeholders to engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills are a must
 Analytical mindset and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to think critically and methodically to resolve complex technical issues
 A passion for delivering excellent customer service and a strong focus on building long-term customer relationships
 Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and keep projects on track. Strong time management and organizational skills are key
 A collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, and engineering teams to deliver customer success
 As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.
 What We Offer 
 An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
 A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
 Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
 Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
 Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
 Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. 
 Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
 Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.  Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
 A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
 Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

 About Zeit AI 
In the coming years, AI agents will take over the work of internal data teams. We’re building the one companies will use.  Your mission 
Forward Deployed Engineers find where real value is hidden in a company’s data and build the apps that unlock it. Half business, half tech: you’re as comfortable in front of a CEO as inside a dataset.
 What you’ll do 
 Spend real time at customer sites, from the CFO’s office to the warehouse floor, and get to the core of an unfamiliar business fast
 Decide what’s worth building, and just as importantly, what isn’t
 Use ZeitMind to connect customer data, model business logic (margins, costs, stock, pricing) and ship operational apps within days
 Present to managing directors and owners, and take them from “interesting demo” to “we run on this every day”
 Own a portfolio of customers end to end, and shape our product and how we deploy it
 What we value 
 You learn fast. New industry, new data, new terms: you get up to speed in no time.
 You bring structure. You break messy problems into clear parts and know where to start.

 We hire across levels, from exceptional early-career talent to senior FDEs who’ve led complex client engagements.
 Backgrounds that fit well (none of these is a must) 
 Consulting. You’ve led client work across industries and know how to win over a managing director.
 Software implementation or value engineering. You’ve rolled out software at customers and made sure it actually got used.
 Data analytics, BI or controlling. You’ve worked hands-on with real company data.
 Technical foundation. You’ve studied something quantitative or picked up SQL along the way, and you like knowing how things work under the hood.
 You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should have a natural pull towards data and technology. ZeitMind does the heavy lifting.
 The basics 
 English at C1 or above. German is a big plus, since many of our customers work in German.
 You’re excited to work in-person in Munich or London and at customer sites, at an early-stage startup pace.
 What we offer 
 Real ownership from day one, full trust and maximum support
 Best tools, zero blockers
 Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass
